Title: Azure Redis Cache: General availability of support for Resource Manager–based virtual networks

Body.Content:
With the launch of the Premium pricing tier, Azure Redis Cache introduced support for classic virtual networks. Azure Redis Cache now supports both classic and Azure Resource Manager–based virtual networks.

For more information and instructions, see How to configure virtual network support for the Premium tier of Azure Redis Cache.
